extraction.description: The screenshot shows UiPath Studio Web/Agent Builder with the Explorer panel open for the Benefit Claims Processing template. The Residency Verification Agent is selected, and its Evaluation Sets page is active. The main panel lists evaluation sets, including “Sample Eval Set (copy)” with 10 evaluations and a 100.00% result for the Residency Validation Evaluator, plus a Default Evaluation Set with no evaluations.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on Residency Verification Agent in the Explorer if it is not already selected. Click on Evaluation Sets under the agent. Click on Sample Eval Set (copy), or use View details, to open and inspect the sample evaluation set results.
